properties.name: app.security.recovery.reset-admin-password
properties.description: When true, the admin account (app.security.admin.email) gets app.security.admin.password as its new password on startup and all its sessions are ended. Read by AdminPasswordReset; remove it again after logging in.

properties.name: app.timezone
properties.description: Time zone (ISO zone id) of the Clock bean, used for dates and "today".
